name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for contrast and visibility on all backgrounds while keeping the indicator large enough for touch users. The trade-off is slightly more visual noise in dense UIs, but it’s necessary for keyboard users who rely on clear focus cues.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring still fails on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the white 2px ring blends into the pattern. A 3px #fff ring alone meets WCAG 2.2 AA on dark patterned backgrounds but disappears on light patterned backgrounds. Settle it with a 5px #fff ring with a 2px #005fcc outer ring—tests on 5 patterned backgrounds prove it.
